correctness.rationale: For \(r_j>0\), direct differentiation gives \(\nabla^2(m_j/r_j)=(m_j/r_j^3)(3u_ju_j^{\mathsf T}-I_2)\), whose trace is \(m_j/r_j^3\). The centrifugal Hessian cancels the \(-I_2\) KCC term. The resulting \(P\) is symmetric with strictly positive trace, so at least one eigenvalue is positive at every regular point. The conclusion is exactly limited to the strict KCC Jacobi criterion.

value.rationale: This is a structural diagnostic for a whole class of planar rotating point-mass systems: the strict KCC criterion labels every regular trajectory Jacobi-unstable, so it cannot distinguish physically stable from unstable orbits in this class. The limitation is useful for interpreting KCC analyses and is not a claim of physical instability.
